name: BYRNES, Alison

headline.note: Documented work includes previously omitted private McDonald’s employment with unknown dates/hours. Full-time party work is explicitly supported; adviser work during an undated study subperiod is also explicitly full-time but excluded as political staff. Remaining transitions and2002–2005 employment are unresolved. Neither headline total is calculable; unknown is not zero.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. Stephen Martin MP (payroll entity unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: Her first speech says she moved to Stephen Martin's office after one and a half years at NSW Labor and describes electorate work as the next job. It does not state the appointment or cessation dates, payroll entity, hours or leave. Martin represented Macarthur and later Cunningham, but his service dates are not substituted for Byrnes's employment dates. Contemporary court record names Byrnes among four staff considered at a26March1996 Corrimal-office staffing meeting. This dates an employment observation, not commencement/cessation. Martin’s1999 thesis acknowledges her administrative/computing assistance; remuneration and whether nested staff duties are unknown. Court details of another employee’s salary, dismissal and contract are not transferred to Byrnes.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. Sharon Bird MP (payroll entity unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: A legitimately public LinkedIn search result separates an executive-assistant role in 2005–2007 from the later adviser role. Byrnes's first speech independently confirms 17 years in Bird's electorate and ministerial offices, while ABC confirms she still worked for Bird in February 2022. Exact dates, payroll entity, hours and leave remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. Sharon Bird MP (payroll entity unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official biography records senior policy and media adviser work from 2005 to 2022. The public LinkedIn result refines the senior role to July 2007–March 2022 and lists the prior executive-assistant position separately. Her first speech confirms work across Bird's electorate and ministerial offices but does not identify when office context, title or payroll changed. Hours, leave and any campaign break remain unresolved. In4September2023 speech she explicitly describes university study in her30s while a full-time adviser. This establishes full-time work during an undated subperiod, not the entire2007–2022 role. Calendar course boundaries and leave remain unknown; no dates calculated from age.

open_questions: What were the exact start and end dates for the full-time NSW Labor accountant's-assistant role?
What were the appointment dates, hours, payroll entity and office locations for the Stephen Martin electorate-officer role?
What employment or other activity fills the period between Stephen Martin's office and Sharon Bird's office, particularly 2002–2005?
What were the exact transition date, payroll entity, hours and leave for the two Sharon Bird roles, including ministerial-office periods and the 2022 campaign?
When did the Master of Management study begin and end, and was it undertaken alongside paid work?
Was there paid work between the LinkedIn-listed March 2022 endpoint and election on 21 May 2022?
research_notes: Systematic follow-up2026-10-01. Added omitted private fast-food work and business-administration study; strengthened1996 political-staff observation and explicit full-time evidence during university study. Required research_notes repaired; preserved supported existing facts.

Corrected age-derived1990 NSW Labor start to null. Neither starting work at16 nor18months commuting supplies a calendar appointment date. This is a precision correction, not a removal of explicit full-time evidence. The frozen roster is untouched.

Full-time adviser statement is limited to study overlap: the whole adviser spell retains unknown employment_status because unlocated subperiod evidence cannot establish uninterrupted full-time service across2007–2022. No separately additive duplicate employment spell created. Relevant statement retained in both study and work evidence notes.

Searched own first speech and2023 education speech, official parliamentary/party biographies, public LinkedIn index,1997 court record,1999 university thesis, early work and2002–2005 gap queries, graduation/full-time/campaign searches. LinkedIn direct open failed; AustLII inaccessible; thesis download403. Available primary speeches and reproduced judgment supplied substantive evidence; no source restrictions bypassed.

Excluded namesakes: US artist/University of Michigan, Ergon worker Allison Byrnes, Ares Management professional and overseas teaching records. Spouse’s NSW parliamentary employment is not hers. Generic association/union thank-you lists are not employment evidence. Thesis assistance is not automatically university employment.
